title.value: On-the-Fly Attention Modulation for Neural Generation
title.justification: The title is explicitly mentioned at the beginning of the paper.
title.quote: On-the-Fly Attention Modulation for Neural Generation

analysis.description: The paper introduces an 'on-the-fly attention modulation' method to improve neural text generation by injecting priors into the attention mechanism during inference. This approach addresses issues like text degeneration by enhancing fluency, creativity, and commonsense reasoning of generated text. The method is evaluated on three benchmarks showing improvements over existing neural generation models.

type.justification: The paper involves experimental evaluations and analyses on neural text generation benchmarks.
type.quote: Automatic and human evaluation results on three text generation benchmarks demonstrate that attention modulation helps LMs generate text with enhanced fluency, creativity, and commonsense reasoning, in addition to significantly reduce sentence-level repetition.

name.justification: The paper primarily deals with neural language models and text generation.
name.quote: Neural text generation is critical for a wide range of downstream natural language applications.

name.justification: The paper specifically addresses issues and improvements in neural text generation.
name.quote: Neural text generation still suffers from degeneration: the generated text is repetitive, generic, self-contradictory, and often lacks commonsense.

name.justification: GPT-2 is the model used for experimentation in this research.
